title: Strengthen nonlinear Eisenstein bounds using port polar ranks (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. For fixed-support Eisenstein messages with one shared scalar quadratic form at each input port,

```text
C >= N - sum_t rank(B_t)/2
coordinate-face example: 198
new product-affine bound: 199
actual example charge: 200
```

Here B_t is the alternating polar form of the used quadratic at port t. The proof determines the exact maximum dimension of a product of affine input spaces that linearizes every message. The dense family q=(sum u_i)(sum v_i) has coordinate restriction loss s and affine restriction loss one. This strengthens a nonlinear obstruction; it supplies no cheaper code or new kappa.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ywz65 / #2607 for the open nonlinear-payload direction, Michael Fischler / #814 for the nonlinear message contract, Jose Manuel / #2017 for the cited block-linear floor, Jonathan Lam / #798 and Joel Pulikkan for geometry/pricing, Nick Petalas / #4895 for coordinate restrictions, and the retained lineage. Alternating-form decomposition and isotropic dimensions retain their classical status. No predecessor scientific verifier was audited or replayed.

## Evidence

- Before: the exact coordinate-face obstruction gives 198 on the first strict fixture. After: the new polar certificate gives 199; a literal exact code costs 200.
- Normal and optimized checks agree on all 1,100 quadratic forms through five variables, 387,405 subspace restrictions, 69,677 translated restrictions, 64 vector maps, 1,600 product-subspace restrictions and 1,280 local decoder cases. Six malformed forms reject and four mathematical boundary controls pass.
- Both registered modes and direct warning-strict commands pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only. Direct elapsed times are 0.217/0.217 seconds, below the 120-second per-command bound.
- Metadata, ten committed package/input files and declared source history pass. Official export integrity and all four declared inputs pass. Both modes pass from a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; source corruption rejects and all eleven exported files retain their bytes.
- Warning-strict source compilation and AST inspection pass. Ruff is unavailable locally.

From the repository root, reproduce with the exact local interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/eisenstein-port-quadratic-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/eisenstein-port-quadratic-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/eisenstein-port-quadratic-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/eisenstein-port-quadratic-floor --check-source-history
```

Other hosts may substitute CPython 3.12. Receipts are generated on stdout and bound to file hashes.

## Limitations

The all-width argument invokes #2017's fixed-support linear theorem and the declared additive pairing price. Finite enumeration corroborates the new argument; it is not a proof kernel or independent human review. Only one shared scalar polar form per port is covered. Multiple independent forms at one port, cross-port quadratic products, adaptive queries, errors, private headers and correlated demands remain outside scope. The new bound need not be the optimal message cost.

Physical/native delivery and restoration, complete signed supplier costs, compiler, stock, precision/tape and analytic recovery remain open. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review and formal-kernel verification were not run. The selected frontier and its five assumptions are unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Determine the largest common isotropic input space for two independent quadratic forms at one port. Start with literal small alternating matrices and a complete truth-table oracle; the single-form rank formula does not settle that dimension.
- Construct an exact nonlinear Eisenstein code below total demand, if possible, with every source/reader support, width and charge declared. No such construction or favorable physical invoice is supplied.

## Related open work

The pre-DONE refresh inspected all sixteen open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR. No other PR computes the Eisenstein product-affine restriction dimension or the displayed 198/199 bounds. No extra scientific computations were run to compare other contributions. The directly related #814, #2017, #2607 and #4895 are merged predecessors.

- #6266 proves a bounded-error outgoing-partition threshold for arbitrary nonlinear framed circuits. Its correctness premise, graph contract and quantity differ from this fixed-support zero-error Eisenstein pairing-price bound; no competing numerical value is supplied.

Hosted replay certifies execution of the registered normal and optimized finite checks. The local direct/registered, committed-byte/source-history and read-only export checks listed above also passed. No mathematical check was deferred solely to CI. These checks do not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the all-width written argument.
